    The BGRS Figure 14 cleaving diagram #

    The source has two two-dimensional central vertices joined by lambda, with two incoming and two outgoing one-dimensional leaves. This is the mixed orientation of affine D̃₅ displayed in BGRS Figure 14. The family below uses the four forms/lines

    • e₀ : k → k²,
    • e₁ : k → k²,
    • (1,1) : k² → k, and
    • (c,1) : k² → k.

    Its endomorphisms are scalar, and an isomorphism between parameters forces the parameters to agree. The last theorem leaves only the literal Hom-bifunctor retraction (the source's cleaving assertion) as an ambient callback.
